name: 司潔妮
objective:
本課程提供學生及職前專業人士必備之英語文語言技巧，強調工程專業領域之英文溝通能力之訓練。課程內容依學院專業內容區分並整合英語文之聽說讀寫之能力為未來全球化移動及以英語專業溝通人才培育為目標。
This course aims to provide pre-service engineering students / professionals with the adequate skills of the English language and communicative competence to facilitate their current academic and future career pursuits. Students are encouraged to utilize their domain expertise to participate in professional communication in English. Centered on the training of professional use of the English language, the ESP curriculum as the crux of a highly-integrated work of domain knowledge and the English learning development embodies the indispensable credentials required for a global profession.
schedule:
Week 1: Course Introduction & English Learning Strategies
課程介紹、學習策略說明

Week 2: Cross-cultural Communication & Pronunciation Warm-up
跨文化溝通基礎概念、發音暖身、繞口令與英語遊戲

Week 3: Introducing Yourself & Exchanging Personal Details
自我介紹、字母拼讀、基數與電話號碼

Week 4: Talking about Dates, Times & Schedules
日期、時間、序數、時刻表閱讀與聽力

Week 5: Identifying Objects & Technical Parts
零件與工具名稱、this/that/these/those、基本物件描述

Week 6: Describing Size, Color & Quantity
尺寸、顏色、數量表達；物件描述對話練習

Week 7: Tools and Their Functions 工具部位、用途描述、have 句型與現在簡單式

Week 8: Positions, Locations & Occupations 位置介系詞、職業介紹、工作場域對話

Week 9: Midterm Presentation (1) 期中口語簡報

Week 10: Midterm Presentation (2) & Feedback 期中口語簡報與回饋

Week 11: Describing Movement & Direction 方向副詞、can / can't 表達能力、移動描述

Week 12: Controls, Speed & Operating Instructions 控制裝置、速度單位、imperative + present simple

Week 13: Fluid Systems & Flow 流體系統、進出方向介系詞、流動動詞

Week 14: Circuits & Cause-Effect Relationships 電路詞彙、電學單位、零條件句（If... , ...）

Week 15: Describing Ongoing Actions & Processes 現在進行式、動作描述、拼字規則
Week 16: Materials, Properties & Professional Contact Information 材料屬性、Email/網址唸法、電話應對句型

Week 17: Final Presentation (1) 期末口語簡報

Week 18: Final Presentation (2) & Course Wrap-up 期末口語簡報與課程總結
scorePolicy:
* 選修本課程，請務必準時到班上課；第一堂課請勿缺席。
* Any student who accumulates FIVE unexcused absences in the semester class will receive a no-credit status. 無故缺席 5 次，即無法獲得本課程學分。

(1) Class Performance (CP), including 課程表現，包括:
 - Midterm Presentation / 期中報告: 20%
 - Final Presentation / 期末報告: 20%
 - Class Participation & Activities / 課堂參與及活動: 30%
 - Homework Assignments / 作業: 10%
 - Attendance 出席: 20% (-5% for each absence 無故缺席一堂課 -5%)

(2) School-wide English Proficiency Exam (EPE) 校際英文會考

Overall score 學期科目總分 = 80%(1) 課程 + 20%(2) 會考
延伸教學與資源: ● 參與式創新教學 (Participatory & Innovative Teaching) 強調學生參與與產出，導入翻轉、PBL/專題、設計思考或遊戲化等策略。Emphasizes student engagement and outcomes by adopting strategies such as Flipped Classroom, PBL (Problem/Project- Based Learning), Design Thinking, or Gamification.● 數位科技融入 (Digital Technology Integration) 運用生成式 AI、VR/AR、IoT、IRS 等新興科技輔助教學與評量。Utilizes emerging technologies such as Generative AI, VR/AR, IoT, and IRS (Interactive Response Systems) to facilitate teaching and assessment.
課程對應SDGs指標: SDG4：優質教育（Quality Education）SDG9：產業創新與基礎設施（Industry, Innovation and Infrastructure）
課程是否導入AI: ● 使用生成式 AI 作為教學過程的輔助工具（Use generative AI tools as an aid to the teaching process）● 簡單介紹 AI 的基本概念（Briefly introduce the basic concept of AI）
remarks: Students are expected to use AI responsibly and acknowledge its use when applicable. 學生可於發音、字彙與簡報準備中使用生成式 AI 工具，並負責任地揭示使用情形。
